documents.text: Restore a previous backup of the game state if the current progress file is corrupted.
A graphics processor draws triangles and applies materials, illumination and texture sampling.
A parry deflects an incoming strike and creates an opportunity to counterattack.
A merchant exchanges coins for equipment and supplies; the player's backpack holds acquired objects.
An authoritative host reconciles client prediction and corrects divergent simulation state.
An occlusion filter muffles dialogue when a solid obstruction separates the listener and emitter.
A navigation mesh represents traversable surfaces. A route planner searches connected polygons.
Offer subtitles, remappable controls and adjustable contrast so more players can participate.
If the cooling system cannot dissipate heat, the processor may reduce clock speed.
Moving seldom-used cache pages to a fast solid-state drive releases working memory.
Continuous collision detection prevents a rapidly moving projectile from passing through thin walls.
Co-locate frequently accessed values to improve cache locality and reduce memory traffic.
A withdrawn source must be rejected even if its derived vector survives in a stale index.
Check the original file digest and exact offsets before presenting a quotation as evidence.
An archived release remains accessible as a historical version rather than replacing current documentation.
Short requests can complete earlier when a long prompt is divided into bounded prefill steps.
